meta.title: ORA — Organic Residue Archive: British and Irish Neolithic pottery δ¹³C
meta.cite_as: Satoru / DigiShield Labs (2025). ORA: Organic Residue Archive — compound-specific δ¹³C from British and Irish Neolithic pottery lipid residue studies. CC-BY 4.0. github.com/satoru-bio/ORA
meta.cite_original_studies: Per-record source attribution is mandatory. Cite the original study listed in each record's source.citation field alongside this dataset.
meta.description: Harmonised, value-level dataset of compound-specific δ¹³C (C16:0 and C18:0 fatty acids) extracted from published British and Irish Neolithic pottery lipid residue studies. Δ¹³C = δ¹³C18:0 − δ¹³C16:0. Reference thresholds after Copley et al. 2003 and Evershed et al. 2008 (NW-European C3 context). This dataset is for contextualisation only — it does not classify unknown samples.
meta.aquatic_caveat: Δ¹³C alone cannot resolve aquatic/marine fats from non-ruminant adipose — they overlap. Separating them requires biomarker evidence (isoprenoid acids, C20/C22 APAAs) not captured in this dataset.

qa.qa_notes: d13C_18_0=−20.7 confirmed verbatim from PDF text (pypdf: '/C25520.7'). Column order verified: C16:0=−28.5 appears first, C18:0=−20.7 second — not a column swap (swap gives Δ=−7.8, equally implausible). The value is physically implausible for a C18:0 δ13C in a Neolithic ceramic context; cause is undetermined (typo, production error, or unusual sample). Kept verbatim for citation integrity; value should not be used in quantitative analysis without verification against authors' raw data.
